title: Elimination mechanism of vanillin from non-phenolic β-O-4-type terminals formed in guaiacyl lignin: a combined kinetic and theoretical study
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,41886-41898
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05285H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yuki Hirano, Haruhiko Fukaya, Tsunehisa Miki, Takashi Hosoya, Hisashi Miyafuji
It was demonstrated that the vanillin end group was consumed through pseudo-first-order reactions involving vanillin elimination via an α-oxyanion-assisted elimination process and a side reaction via an acetal-type intermediate.
